title: NFL Football
description:
Tennessee Titans at Cincinnati Bengals
The Cincinnati Bengals host the Tennessee Titans in NFL regular-season play at Paycor Stadium. Cincinnati enters at 4-2 after a 35-13 road win over Baltimore, while Tennessee arrives at 1-6 and have lost three of their last four games.

title: NFL Football
description:
Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos
The Broncos (5-2) host the Chiefs (5-1) in NFL Week 8 at Empower Field at Mile High. Denver arrives off three straight wins after beating Arizona, while Kansas City remains first in the AFC West, despite a 20-3 defeat against Seattle last week.
